verdict.rationale: Fellow's own docs say users automatically receive a meeting summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting. That covers the key points, decisions, and next steps the story asks for, and webhooks fire when an AI note is generated. However, nothing shows the summary arrives right after the meeting or is good enough to share without editing; the action items are only described as 'suggested'. Missing for 10: evidence of post-meeting timing, independent or hands-on corroboration that summaries are share-ready without edits.

support.subject: As a product manager, I get a structured summary right after each meeting — key points, decisions, and next steps — good enough to share without editing

citations.quote: You automatically receive a clear meeting summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting.
Fellow records, transcribes, and summarizes every meeting across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Slack huddles
When an event happens (like an AI note being generated or an action item being completed), Fellow sends an HTTP POST request to the URL you specify with details about the event.
